failure_modes.name: Solver_Irrelevant_Passage_Overprocessing
failure_modes.evidence: In hop 1, the solver analyzes passages about Michelle Lee (singer), Bohemian (band), Park Kwang-su (filmmaker), and Son Jun-ho (actor) - none of which are relevant to verifying a claim about Jay Park, Lee Jun-ho, 2PM, and the 'Take Off' video. These passages are about completely unrelated Korean entertainment figures and groups.

failure_modes.name: Query_Form_Mismatch
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 2 query: 'When was the "Take Off" video released by 2PM, and did this release occur after Jay Park left the group in early 2010?' This is formulated as a natural-language yes/no question with a compound structure bundling two verification targets, rather than a simple entity-focused query.

failure_modes.name: Query_Stagnation
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 3 query targets the same core entities already retrieved: 'Jay Park, Lee Jun-ho, 2PM, Take Off 2PM'. These entities were already successfully retrieved in hops 1 and 2 (passages contain 2PM band info, Lee Jun-ho membership, Jay Park departure date, and Take Off release date). The query fails to advance beyond what was already obtained.
